Name: Stardew Messages - Phone SMS and MMS (Core)
Author: Jybee
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Stardew Messages - SMS/MMS Framework (Core)[/b][/size]
[i]v1.0.1 - Phone UI + engine. Stories come from JSON Content Packs.[/i][/center]
[quote]
[b]In short:[/b] An in-game phone with a real SMS/MMS app (threads, contacts, MMS, gallery).
Plus a lightweight conversation framework (scene intros, choices, triggers & natural pacing),
and a practical quick action to find NPCs in seconds.[/quote]

[size=5][b]What this mod is (and is not)[/b][/size]
[b]This file is the CORE.[/b] It provides the phone UI + the engine.  
It does [b]not[/b] include story content by itself.  
To receive NPC conversations, install at least one [b]JSON Content Pack[/b].

[b]Recommended starter pack:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41917][b]Vanilla FirstContact (Content Pack)[/b][/url]

[size=5][b]The main pillars[/b][/size]

[b]1) The Phone (SMS/MMS)[/b]
[list]
[*]Inbox with conversation threads (unread markers, recent sorting)[/*]
[*]Clean in-thread reading (scroll, message bubbles)[/*]
[*]Phone-like navigation (messages / contacts / gallery)[/*]
[/list]
[b]2) MMS Gallery[/b]
[list]
[*]MMS images inside threads (image + caption)[/*]
[*]Gallery app: thumbnails → full view → next/previous[/*]
[*]Optional filters (depending on pack metadata)[/*]
[/list]
[b]3) Story Scenes Engine[/b] (this is where it becomes more than “just texting”)
[list]
[*][b]Mystery Contact[/b]: start anonymous, reveal the contact at the right moment[/*]
[*][b]Multi-choice replies[/b]: 1/2/3 options for RP & variations[/*]
[*][b]Triggers + Delivery Queue[/b]: messages arrive with natural pacing (no flood)[/*]
[/list]
[b]4) JSON-only Content Packs[/b]
[list]
[*]No C# required for story content: conversations, triggers, choices, i18n… in JSON[/*]
[*]Community-friendly: creators can publish their own packs[/*]
[*]Translation-ready via i18n tokens[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Quick install[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Install SMAPI[/*]
[*]Drop this mod into: Stardew Valley/Mods/[/*]
[*]Install at least one Content Pack (recommended above)[/*]
[*]Launch the game - messages will arrive naturally during gameplay[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Changelog[/b][/size]
[b]1.0.0[/b] - Initial public release:
[list]
[*]Messages UI (threads + unread)[/*]
[*]MMS + Gallery[/*]
[*]Delivery Queue (anti-flood)[/*]
[*]Triggers[/*]
[*]Mystery Contact intros (anonymous → reveal)[/*]
[*]QuickWhere[/*]
[*]Deterministic content pack priority[/*]
[/list]
[b]1.0.1[/b] - Multiplayer improvements:
[list]
[*]Moved state to per-player local JSON storage (no more overwriting host data)[/*]
[*]QuickWhere: fixed multiplayer reliabilit[/*]
[/list]
[b]1.0.2[/b] - Save & UI improvements:
[list]
[*]UI[b]:[/b] added F9 (default) to cycle the HUD button position (prevents overlap with other UI mods) + optional chat notification when new messages arrive.[/*]
[*]Persistence[b]:[/b] upgraded JSON save system with a snapshot + WAL (write-ahead log) for safer, more reliable data storage.[/*]
[/list]
[b]1.0.3[/b] - New & improvements:
[list]
[*]Conversation chaining system between contacts (same pack)[/*]
[*]Inbox sorting is now deterministic:[/*]
[*]  ﻿unread first[/*]
[*]  ﻿then read[/*]
[*]  ﻿newest first within each group[/*]
[/list]
1.0.4 - New & improvements:
[list]
[*]Custom contact names can now be translated through i18n with `DisplayNameKey`.[/*]
[*]Added `DailyLuck` / `MinDailyLuck` trigger condition based on Stardew Valley’s real daily luck.[/*]
[*]Added visual highlighting for unread incoming messages inside conversations.[/*]
[*]Conversations are now marked as read when leaving the thread, not immediately when opening it.[/*]
[*]Opening one conversation no longer marks unread messages from other conversations as read.[/*]
[/list]
